annotations.title: Search the tables of an EU act

description: SEARCH THE ROWS OF AN EU ACT'S TABLES for the words of a question or for a code. A row matches when EVERY word is in it, in whichever of its cells («criogenice GNL» finds the row whose product and code sit in two cells); diacritics and case are ignored. Each match comes with the ids of its cells, the row under the column names, its place in the table, the rows above and below, and the table's title. Use mode 'exact' for a code (a CN code, an EC number): the word must be a whole cell, and a trailing * makes it a prefix (8414*). It searches ONE act or ONE table (celex or table is required), by words: it does not search by meaning. The answer says when the act has tables with no cells in the database, which were not searched.

celex.description: The EU act that holds the tables: its CELEX, e.g. '32014R0833' (a base act: it is followed to the consolidated version in force, and the answer says so) or '02014R0833-20260717' (that exact version).

columns.description: Look in these columns only: names or numbers, comma separated.

mode.description: 'lexical' (default): each word is contained in a cell. 'exact': each word is a whole cell (code); a trailing * makes it a prefix.

neighbors.description: Rows shown above and below each match (default 1).

query.description: The words or the code to look for, up to eight words; stopwords are dropped.

rows_per_table.description: Most rows taken from one table (default 3).

table.description: The table, as list_eu_tables or search_eu_tables printed it: 'tabel-ue:176080512.2' (or just 176080512 when the node holds one table).

name: search_eu_tables
